title: A session that started other sessions never opens the question box
why: Your feedback, Oct 27 15:51 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh21vJLZeSrqXyLEvzPyoXgLz): the Banchi orchestrator opened the question box because none of its own agents or commands were running, and blocked while the lane sessions it had started waited on it to route answers and merge.
note: The rule is the problem: questions-go-to-owner bars the box while "an agent, a lane or a background command" runs, and c86's check (session-board mod, PR 665) counts only the session's own agents, commands and workflows, never the separate sessions it started. Fix: an orchestrator, meaning any session that has started another session or lane, asks on the waiting page only and never opens the box; the rule says so in one line, and the mod refuses AskUserQuestion once the session has started a session (start_session or a lane spawn recorded on its board). Red first on a session with a live started session and no running agent. Needs no answer. Port: no; the rule and the mod install from claude-settings. Placed ahead of c148 (triage, Oct 27): one open box stalled every lane under that orchestrator. Doing: lane started Oct 28 CDT, built at fcbafb4 (Opus): the box is refused once the session made a successful start_session or create_session call, and the count survives a reload; red 3 of 138 on old code, then green; Opus review round 1 running.
